commands: for url in 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bigodines/cid10/master/cid10.json' 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wesleylq/cid10/main/data/cid10.json' 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pauloricardoferreira/cid10/main/data.json' 'https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v1/localidades/municipios' ; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 8 "$url" 2>/dev/null); echo "$code $url"; done
